name: Waterberg Plateau: Mountain View walk
why: A short steep climb from the rest camp to the edge of the red sandstone plateau, with the Kalahari bush flat to the horizon.
book: Park entry and maps at Waterberg Resort reception (Bernabe de la Bat rest camp). No permit for the camp walks.
water: Carry 1 litre; water and the restaurant at the camp.
dangers: The last part to the top is steep scrambling on rock.
Troops of baboons: keep food out of sight.
Summer heat up to 40 °C: walk early.
turnaround: Do not go up after 16:00: be back in camp before dark.

points.name: Waterberg rest camp
points.note: By the restaurant, under the red cliffs. The German cemetery of 1904 and the old mission ruins are a few minutes' walk south.

points.name: Waterberg Plateau Viewpoint
points.note: The plateau edge above the camp. Return the same way.
